*I’d block shipment on one renewal-scheduling bug.*

*P1 — Clamp to the target month, not the source month* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`

`daysInMonth(year, month)` uses the month of `from`, but the result is constructed in `month + 1`. This both skips February renewals through JavaScript date overflow and renews too early after short months:

| From / anchor | Actual renewal | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Jan 31, 2026 / 31 | Mar 3 | Feb 28 |
| Jan 31, 2028 / 31 | Mar 2 | Feb 29 |
| Feb 28, 2026 / 31 | Mar 28 | Mar 31 |
| Apr 30, 2026 / 31 | May 30 | May 31 |

Clamp the original anchor against the number of days in the *destination* month. Add regression coverage for January → February → March in ordinary and leap years, plus a 30-day → 31-day transition.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but a calendar sweep across 2024–2028 found 66 incorrect results out of 1,860 cases. The existing scheduling tests miss month-length transitions.

Reviewed `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d` against `main` at `7f89e48`. No files changed.
